name: Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension of Majority
proof: On the majority class, both the established VC and Littlestone dimensions equal $n$. The surveyed sandwich theorem places Prefix-k Littlestone Dimension between them, so its value is $n$ for every fixed k.
references: Derived from Proposition \ref{prop:prefix-littlestone-order} in the survey and the established majority benchmark values
